model: risked-project-npv: HMW Phase 1 cash-flow NPV plus resource optionality (engine route)

equity_bridge.note: ~9.2Mt LCE of resource not consumed by 40 years of Phase 1 (9.5Mt total: HMW 7.87Mt, Candelas 1.63Mt; FY2026 AR Table 1) at ~A$5/t LCE. Deliberately far below the Phase 2 DFS NPV8 of US$1,993m (Oct 2023, at US$22,841/t realised) - at the base deck a 21ktpa build roughly earns its capital and no more. Applied in all scenarios; in the bull case Phase 2 is modelled explicitly in the flows, so this item there represents Phases 3-4 and Candelas only.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: not applicable - pre-revenue; drivers are built from tonnes x price, not from a historical CAGR
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (A$38.3m FY2021 -> A$116.4m FY2023 -> A$234.6m FY2026) is entirely share issuance, not retained earnings: shares on issue rose from 212.5m to 1,264.4m over the same five years while accumulated losses reached A$77.0m. Revenue, EPS and FCF CAGRs are undefined (nil revenue, negative EPS and FCF in every period).
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF FY2026 = reported FCF -33.149 - SBC 5.897 - interest income 0.728 = -39.774. Reported FCF: FY2023 -36.3, FY2024 -77.5, FY2025 -46.3, FY2026 -33.1 (construction spend; Authium absorbed the ~A$65.5m processing plant).

scenario_narratives.base: Phase 1 works, late and a little dearer than the DFS. First concentrate sales land in the December 2026 quarter as guided, but FY2027 delivers only ~1.0kt LCE from the ~9-10kt LCE pond inventory; nameplate 4ktpa is reached during FY2028 and the 5.2ktpa expansion fills by FY2030. Lithium carbonate averages US$14,000/t in real terms and Authium pays ~68% of that for 6% LiCl concentrate, giving ~A$74m of revenue and ~A$26m of EBITDA at plateau after site cost of US$5,000/t (including the Authium toll), royalty and corporate overhead. Phase 2 is not built: at this deck it roughly earns its capital. Value is the Phase 1 annuity, the cash, and a modest per-tonne value for 9Mt of undeveloped resource.
scenario_narratives.bull: The lithium deficit the bullish forecasters expect arrives as Galan ramps: carbonate holds US$19,000/t and concentrate payability matches the DFS 72%. Nanofiltration performs, 5.2ktpa is reached in FY2029, and with Phase 1 generating ~A$60m a year of EBITDA and RIGI in place Galan secures the 20ktpa permit and funds Phase 2 (A$823m, FY2029-33), reaching 21ktpa in FY2034 at a 67% EBITDA margin. This needs four independent things - price, ramp, permit and ~A$460m of external funding on fair terms - which is why it carries the lowest weight.
scenario_narratives.bear: The 2027 oversupply case plays out as Galan enters the market: carbonate sits at US$11,000/t, Authium's formula pays 64%, and the switch from the DFS liming flowsheet to nanofiltration plus Puna weather keeps output at 4.4ktpa rather than 5.2ktpa. Phase 1 barely covers site and corporate cost and never earns a return, guidance slips again (it has already moved from H1 2026 to H2 2026 to Q4 2026), and the company burns through its cash and raises equity at a discount, as it did at A$0.105-0.11 in FY2025. The terminal value sits on the zero floor; what is left is cash, less the burn, plus what an acquirer would pay for the resource.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Galan is valued as a built but unproven single asset, not as an operating company with a record to extrapolate. The Phase 1 cash flows are built from tonnes, a deliberately mid-cycle lithium price deck and site costs marked up from the 2023 DFS; the DFS NPVs (US$460m Phase 1, US$1,993m Phase 2) are not used because they rest on realised prices of US$20-23k/t LCE, roughly double the base deck here. The three scenarios differ on lithium price, ramp-up delivery and whether Phase 2 is ever built, and the weights carry the execution and funding risk. The result is dominated by the price deck: each US$1,000/t on the carbonate price moves base value by roughly A$0.03 a share.
key_risks_to_valuation: Lithium price deck is the dominant driver and is an assumption, not an observation: base US$14,000/t carbonate, 68% concentrate payability. The Authium offtake pricing formula is not disclosed.

Funding gap: base FY2027 owner FCF of about -A$37m against A$35.5m of cash at 30 June 2026 and an undrawn US$6m prepayment. A placement at or below the current price would dilute every per-share value here; the share count is held flat.
Ramp-up: first sales guidance has slipped H1 2026 -> H2 2026 -> Q4 2026; nanofiltration replaced the DFS flowsheet without a commercial-scale precedent at HMW.
Site operating cost is an estimate (US$5,000/t LCE base incl. toll) - Galan has not yet reported a production cost; the DFS figure of US$3,963/t predates the technology switch.
Resource optionality (A$45m, A$5/t LCE) is a judgment; it is two-thirds of bear equity value.
Bull case funds A$823m of Phase 2 capex at fair value with no dilution penalty.
Cash anchor is the 30 June 2026 balance; four and a half months of ramp-up spend have occurred since.

inputs.base_revenue_note: NOTIONAL. Galan has never recorded revenue (FY2018-FY2026 all nil). The engine compounds from a base, so FY0 is set to A$1.0m and the year-1 growth rate is the number that lands FY2027 revenue on the modelled first-sales tonnage x realised price. Read the revenue path in projections, not the growth percentages.
inputs.share_count_basis: 1,267.537m ordinary shares at 22 Sep 2026 (FY2026 AR shareholder information) + treasury-method dilution at the current price: 90.909m options at A$0.15 (Clean Elements, exp Sep/Nov 2028) = 30.30m net shares, 0.5m options at A$0.165 = 0.13m, 0.961m zero-price options, 3.413m service rights. EXCLUDED as out of the money: 16.5m director performance rights (price hurdles A$1.75-3.50), 47.6m GLNOB listed options at A$0.65, 5m at A$0.35, 1m at A$0.50. Held flat: any equity raise needed to cover the FY2027 funding gap is NOT in the count (see key risks).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2026 Annual Report cash-flow reconciliation (share-based payments 5,896,705); mostly amortisation of 16.5m director performance rights with A$1.75-3.50 price hurdles, running off Feb/Dec 2027
inputs.commodity_deck_note: Flows are USD-priced and translated at AUD/USD 0.67 (Yahoo AUDUSD=X 0.6774 on 2026-11-13). Battery-grade lithium carbonate, flat real: bear US$11,000/t, base US$14,000/t, bull US$19,000/t. LiCl concentrate payability bear 64% / base 68% / bull 72% (the July 2023 Phase 1 DFS assumed ~72% of carbonate; the Authium offtake price formula is undisclosed, so base is haircut). Realised US$/t LCE: 7,040 / 9,520 / 13,680. The DFS deck was US$20,252/t realised - roughly double this base - which is why the DFS NPV8 of US$460m is not used as the anchor.
inputs.wacc_rationale: 12% nominal in AUD, the same in all three scenarios (risk is charged once, in the flows and the weights, not in a scenario-specific rate). Built as AUD risk-free ~4.4% + 5.5% ERP x ~1.4 beta for a single-asset lithium equity, no debt so WACC = cost of equity. No separate Argentina premium is stacked on: ramp failure, price and funding risk sit in the bear path and its 30% weight; RIGI gives 30-year fiscal stability. The DFS 8% is a real project rate, not an equity rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment B (lease as operating cost). The A$12.8m nanofiltration-plant lease liability is the present value of A$400/t-of-concentrate toll payments to Authium (capped 30,000t, ~A$1,250/t LCE); the toll is carried inside site operating cost in the EBITDA margin and lease liabilities (A$13.04m) are EXCLUDED from net debt. lease_cost_pct_path left at zero to avoid charging it twice.
inputs.nci_treatment: None - HMW and Candelas are 100% owned.
inputs.notes: MODEL CHOICE: pre-revenue single-project lithium brine developer in ramp-up. dcf-methods SKILL.md has no routing row for this; the folder precedent (SMI.NZ) is a risked project NAV rather than an owner-FCF extrapolation, because there is no operating history - every historical FCF is construction spend. Unlike SMI.NZ the project here is BUILT and commissioned, so instead of risking a study NPV the Phase 1 cash flows are built bottom-up (tonnes x realised price - site cost - royalty - corporate cost) and run through the component engine, with scenarios on the three things that actually decide value: lithium price, ramp-up delivery, and whether the Phase 2 expansion gets built. Undeveloped resource is added in the equity bridge. Historical CAGRs are not used to set any driver. BEAR SITS ON THE TERMINAL-VALUE FLOOR: at US$11k carbonate and a 4.4ktpa plateau Phase 1 does not cover site plus corporate cost, so bear value is cash + resource optionality less the burn - a finding, not a rounding detail. FUNDING GAP: base FY2027 owner FCF is about -A$37m against A$35.5m cash at 30 June 2026; the undrawn US$6m Authium prepayment covers it only just, so a further placement is more likely than not. ANCHOR VINTAGE: cash is the 30 June 2026 balance; the September 2026 quarterly cash balance was not in the extracted filings and should replace it when available. Standard P/E and EV/EBITDA sanity checks are meaningless here; price is ~1.2x book (NTA A$0.185/share) and EV ~A$250m is ~US$18/t of the 9.5Mt LCE resource.

bear.volume_note: Sales kt LCE: FY27 0.5, FY28 2.5, FY29 3.5, FY30 4.0, FY31+ 4.4 (nameplate never fully reached). Realised A$10,507/t LCE (US$7,040 at 0.67), +2%/yr from FY32.
bear.cost_note: Site cost US$6,800/t FY28 -> US$5,600/t at plateau, 3% royalty, corporate cut to A$6m.
bear.capex_note: Expansion curtailed: A$12m FY27, A$4m FY28, then ~A$2.3m/yr sustaining.

base.volume_note: Sales kt LCE by June FY: FY27 1.0, FY28 3.8, FY29 4.8, FY30+ 5.2. Realised A$14,209/t LCE (US$9,520 at 0.67), +2%/yr nominal from FY31.
base.cost_note: Site cash cost incl. Authium toll US$5,600/t FY28 -> US$5,000/t at plateau (DFS US$3,963/t in 2023 dollars before the technology switch; inflated and scaled for a 5ktpa operation), 3% provincial royalty, A$7m corporate. FY27 is a ramp year: ~A$24m site + A$7m corporate against A$14m revenue.
base.capex_note: FY27 ~A$18m 5.2ktpa pond expansion + A$1m sustaining; FY28 ~A$6m; thereafter ~A$2.6m/yr sustaining (DFS US$59m over 40 years).
base.tax_note: RIGI 25% rate, reached FY31 after start-up losses and accelerated depreciation are used.

bull.volume_note: Sales kt LCE: FY27 1.5, FY28 4.0, FY29-30 5.2, then Phase 2: FY31 8, FY32 13, FY33 18, FY34+ 21. Realised A$20,418/t LCE (US$13,680 at 0.67), flat nominal to FY34 then +2%.
bull.cost_note: Site cost US$4,800/t FY28 falling to US$3,800/t at 21ktpa (Phase 2 DFS US$3,510/t), 3% royalty, corporate A$8-11m.
bull.capex_note: Phase 2 incremental capex A$823m (DFS US$429m x 1.25 escalation at 0.67) spent FY29-FY33: 80 / 250 / 250 / 170 / 73, plus sustaining. Peak cumulative funding need ~A$460m, several times what Galan has ever raised - assumed financed at fair value (debt, prepayment or strategic partner).
bull.tax_note: 25% RIGI rate, dipping to 15% FY31-32 on accelerated depreciation of Phase 2 assets.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 10x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% house default: single project, single offtaker, a processing flowsheet unproven at commercial scale, first-sales guidance that has slipped three times, and a base-case FY2027 burn that consumes essentially all the cash on hand. Base 50%: construction and commissioning are complete and first LiCl has been produced, so a working Phase 1 at mid-cycle prices is the central case. Bull cut to 20% from 35%: it requires a sustained high lithium price, a clean ramp, a Phase 2 permit and several hundred million dollars of external funding, all together.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
sanity_check.checks_replaced: model is risked_npv: no multiples rule applies; the historical table is reported for context only
